description: This file contains test suite code for verifying the behavior of slow consumer detection and backpressure algorithms in an EventHub streaming setup within the Orleans distributed application framework. It defines a test class with setup fixtures, and individual test methods that simulate slow consumers and healthy consumers to examine how the system manages backpressure.

classes.name: EHSlowConsumingTests
classes.description: A test class for evaluating backpressure and slow consumer detection in an EventHub streaming context, utilizing Orleans testing infrastructure.

methods.name: EHSlowConsuming_ShouldFavorSlowConsumer
methods.description: Main test method to verify that the system favors slow consumers and handles backpressure correctly.

methods.name: SetUpHealthyConsumerGrain
methods.description: Sets up multiple healthy consumer grains for testing.

methods.name: StopHealthyConsumerGrainComing
methods.description: Stops multiple consumer grains as part of test cleanup.

methods.name: AssertCacheBackPressureTriggered
methods.description: Asserts whether backpressure is correctly triggered or cleared.

methods.name: IsBackPressureTriggered
methods.description: Checks the current backpressure status via management grain.

methods.name: EHSlowConsuming_ShouldFavorSlowConsumer
methods.description: Main test logic for simulating slow consumers and verifying backpressure behavior.

methods.name: SetUpHealthyConsumerGrain
methods.description: Helper to instantiate and configure multiple healthy consumer grains.

methods.name: IsBackPressureTriggered
methods.description: Queries the backpressure status across the system.
